name: dependency-version-check
description: Warn when package.json dependencies are missing or installed versions do not satisfy their requirements.
author: amoonnra

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Dependency checks work in Restricted Mode; installation requires workspace trust.

commands.title: Dependency Version Check: Refresh All Projects
Dependency Version Check: Install / Update Active Project Dependencies
Dependency Version Check: Show Affected Projects

dependencyVersionCheck.enabled.description: Check declared dependencies against installed packages.

dependencyVersionCheck.notifications.description: Notify about the active file's project outside package.json. Closing defers unchanged requirements and problems; dependency changes or Git HEAD changes can notify again.

dependencyVersionCheck.pollIntervalSecon.description: Fallback refresh interval for branch switches and installations missed by file watchers.

dependencyVersionCheck.exclude.description: Glob for directories excluded from recursive project discovery.

dependencyVersionCheck.checkPeerDependen.description: Check peerDependencies; missing optional peers are ignored.

dependencyVersionCheck.checkOptionalDepe.description: Also warn about missing optionalDependencies. Installed optional packages are always checked.

dependencyVersionCheck.packageManager.description: Installation manager. Auto uses packageManager, then the nearest installation-root lockfile, then npm.

dependencyVersionCheck.installCommand.description: Custom shell command run only in the active file's project directory, for example npm run deps:install. Empty uses a project-scoped package manager command.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
